clips.title: The story
paras: Winstone Wolfe is a human operative affiliated with the secretive Ravenholdt organization, stationed at their secluded estate nestled between Hillsbrad and the Alterac Mountains. He keeps watch over the estate's grounds and groundskeepers, serving as one of the trusted contacts within the hidden league of thieves and assassins.

Tucked away in the hidden valley of Ravenholdt Manor, Winstone Wolfe operates among the ranks of Lord Jorach Ravenholdt's syndicate. Quiet, watchful, and practical, Wolfe is one of the capable hands who handles business around the manor, ensuring that only those with proper discretion and talent walk the grounds undisturbed.
